优化文档

- Initial release of openclaw-automation-recipes.
- Includes 10 ready-to-use automation scenarios for tasks like news summaries, email replies, GitHub issue monitoring, price tracking, meeting reminders, content publishing, data backup, social media monitoring, and smart scheduling.
- Recipes are provided in straightforward YAML format for easy customization.
- Usage instructions and support contact information are included.
